lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Partner,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I want to tell you something.
What is it?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Sealed in this right eye of mine

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: is the One-Winged Dark Lord.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I am doing everything in my power

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: to prevent that seal from being broken,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: but a weakened One-Winged Dark Lord is a One-Winged Dark Lord nonetheless.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: It is waiting for me to let down my guard.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: If by any chance

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I falter, and the One-Winged Dark Lord is let loose,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: you must make a decision.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Submit to the chaos and be engulfed,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: or...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: entrust everything to me,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Guillotine De Mephisto?
I would submit to the chaos.
I would trust you.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You fool!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I thought you would be different,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: but you are indeed just another facile human being...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hehehe!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I knew I could count on you, Partner.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Your sentiments resonate deeply with me.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I, Guillotine De Mephisto, will not disappoint you.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I will resist until the bitter end.
But, what's your actual plan?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Should this truly come to pass,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I will summon Adramelech.
Oh, right... that.
The legendary demon who's also a Sun God?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hehe, there's no need for you to feign knowledge.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: The existence of a legendary demon who also happens to be a Sun God

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: is far beyond the grasp of mere mortals like yourself.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: My goodness!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: To know the true form of Adramelech...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: you are truly no mere mortal.
What happens when you summon it?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: To summon Adramelech,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: a powerful sacrifice is required.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: When that time comes,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I must give everything I have.
And what will happen to you?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: When I said everything, I meant it.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: My power alone may not be sufficient to thwart the beast,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: so I have no choice but to discard this entire body.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: As for you, you must be prepared

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: for this potential eventuality.
I have no intention of giving up on you or this world.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Bwahahahaha!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Your recklessness is most humorous,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: but I admire your courage.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You manage to liven up

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: even this filthy demonic realm.
